name: superpowers
description: Skills for test-driven development, debugging and planning work in steps. Needs nothing.

name: ponytail
description: Pushes Claude toward the shortest solution that works, with review and audit commands. Needs nothing.

name: scope-guard
description: Counts the files a turn edits and stops at a threshold so you restate the goal. Needs Claude Code 2.1.287 or newer.

name: smart-compact
description: Compacts at a good moment: after a commit or green tests, or just before the prompt cache expires. Needs Claude Code 2.1.295 or newer.

name: micro-compaction
description: Adds /compact micro, which drops old file reads and thinking from the transcript without a model summary. Needs Claude Code 2.1.287 or newer.

name: cache-tax
description: Keeps the one-hour prompt cache warm during breaks and warns once before a cold send. Warming sends model requests that cost tokens. Needs Claude Code 2.1.287 or newer.

name: secret-box
description: Lets Claude use a secret without seeing it: you paste the key in a masked box and Claude gets a placeholder. Needs Claude Code 2.1.287 or newer.

name: modwall
description: Shows what each mod can reach as it loads and holds or refuses it by your policy. Needs Claude Code 2.1.287 or newer.

name: claude-code-setup
description: Reads a codebase and recommends hooks, skills, MCP servers and subagents for it. Needs nothing.

name: mod-scout
description: Ranks the mods you would use most from your recent sessions, with a skill that designs them. Needs Claude Code 2.1.287 or newer and Node 18 or newer.

name: codex
description: Use OpenAI Codex from Claude Code to review code or hand off tasks. Needs Node 18.18 or newer, the Codex CLI and a ChatGPT account or OpenAI API key.

name: session-board
description: A floating board of running Claude Code sessions, with a jump to the tmux window of the one you pick. Needs tmux.

name: diagram-design
description: Draws diagrams (architecture, flowcharts, sequence, ER and more) as self-contained HTML and SVG. Needs nothing.

name: diagram-pane
description: A side pane that pins every diagram Claude draws and keeps a live map of the work. Needs Claude Code 2.1.287 or newer.

name: impeccable
description: Design commands for frontend work: critique, audit, polish and anti-pattern checks. Needs nothing.

name: modern-web-guidance
description: Keeps Claude current on modern web best practices, including a Chrome extensions skill. Needs nothing.

name: watch
description: Lets Claude watch a video from a link or file: frames, captions or Whisper transcript. Needs ffmpeg and yt-dlp.

name: typesafe
description: Skills for designing workflows with the TypeSafe System One API and finding its current docs. Needs nothing to install.
